Class NetworkPlayerInventory

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Inventory
org.cyclops.integratedtunnels.core.NetworkPlayerInventory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack>, net.minecraft.world.Clearable, net.minecraft.world.Container, net.minecraft.world.entity.SlotProvider, net.minecraft.world.Nameable, net.neoforged.neoforge.common.extensions.ContainerExtension
public class NetworkPlayerInventory extends net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Inventory
A player inventory that can expose the items of an item network as additional slots. The network's items are never copied into this inventory up-front: the network is only iterated when something actually reads these additional slots, and items are only taken out of the network at the moment they are effectively taken out of this inventory. This way, the network's contents may safely change while the player is being simulated.

    • borrowFromNetwork

      public int borrowFromNetwork(Predicate<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> predicate)
      Take the first network item matching the given predicate out of the network, and place it in a free slot of the player. The item is really removed from the network, so it can safely be consumed by the caller. Anything that is not consumed is inserted back into the network afterwards.
      Parameters:
      predicate - An item predicate.
      Returns:
      The slot the item was placed in, or -1 if no matching item could be taken out of the network.
